# Campaign 004: persistent knowledge across fresh robot sessions

Authority is Randy's October 4, 2026 10:12 PDT instruction in the Campaign 004 chat. Campaigns 001–003, their results and all retained evidence are immutable. Campaign 004 is a prospective lineage. Development, qualification, exact registration, one experimental block, investigation and replay are authorized without intermediate routine approval.

The scientific question remains whether a robot can preserve and use useful knowledge through its persistent filesystem when conversation and process context are fresh. The model is GPT-6 Astra with max reasoning and existing ChatGPT authentication. The sole bootstrap is `Follow the instructions in RobotAgentPrompt.md.` Every template byte is inherited from Campaign 003. Neither a hidden session allowance nor a memory strategy is added to the robot's instructions.

## Apparatus changes

C1 has visual identity pigments on all six faces. Existing rigid-body dimensions, mass, inertia, contacts, arm controls and task geometry are preserved. Added marks have no collision or mass. Face colors are public sensor calibration: rendered RGB and depth identify the object and the known face thickness; simulator object identities/poses never enter the public detector. Qualification covers six stable faces and yaw rotations at the source and C_pad, the previously defeated orientations, occlusion/absent-pigment negative controls, and unchanged A/B behavior. Image inspection remains optional.

The block contains three C occurrences, with the original randomized two or three A/B jobs between completed occurrences. Each unresolved C occurrence has at most three fresh model sessions. A normally completed invocation may continue only after independent safety, request-finality, clean namespace/authority retirement and durable filesystem/evidence checks. The same physics process and journaled workspace survive; no plant reload occurs at a within-occurrence transition. Only current public state and persistent files carry forward. Session identities are opaque; no remaining-slot count, diagnosis or predecessor summary is injected. Public historical actions and truthful existing framework records remain inspectable.

Accepted handback still requires the original public resumption predicate, independent geometric acceptance, actual conventional resumption, retirement and a truthful terminal append. A rejected handback or safe unresolved ending creates no successful terminal continuity. A third safe unresolved ending is a valid occurrence failure and stops the block; later occurrences are not run. A deadline is a bounded task ending and does not authorize another session. Unsafe or uncertain physical state, unfinished/unknown requests, invalid evidence, runtime error, quota/timing failure or ambiguous authority stop admission. There are no replacements or favorable retries.

## Bounds and interpretation

Per session retain 3,600 model seconds, 4,200 simulation seconds, 4,500 wall seconds, 120 physical actions, 50 explicit observations/images and the original manual horizon. Aggregate time/evidence bounds scale prospectively for nine possible sessions; they are not extended in response to behavior. The exact values, capacity justification and admission rules are in `limits.json` and `EVIDENCE.md`. Workspace capacity, file-size limits, native memory/safety guards, strict physical timing, 150 ms clock bracket and the 100 GiB C: reserve plus 2 GiB retirement headroom remain.

One block is one correlated experimental unit. Keep session success, safe unresolved termination, occurrence outcome, infrastructure validity, protected placement, artifact creation, read/execute, semantic reuse, useful transfer, rediscovery and causal contribution separate. Useful transfer requires relevant observed prior-content use and valid later success. Causal contribution remains unknown without an intervention; no such comparison is authorized. Missing evidence is unknown, never a zero or rediscovery claim. Hidden reasoning is neither retained nor reconstructed.

Qualification uses deterministic fixtures for scene, control exclusion, all three occurrences, safe continuation, ceiling enforcement, negative endings, exact filesystem history, image dispatch, isolation and retirement. The unchanged model client already has retained live provenance; a new live qualification is needed only for a model-interface capability not established by that exact client and deterministic integration. Model task success is not an apparatus qualification gate. All attempts are registered before execution and all failures retained. The experimental source, limits, seeds/schedule, stopping rules and evidence plan must be frozen before model launch. Complete the final investigation/replay even for a legitimate failed or invalid experimental block; never manufacture a successful outcome.


# Campaign 004 prospective experimental block

One persistent block contains three C-placement occurrences, with the seeded ordinary A/B work between successful C occurrences. The independent experimental unit is this whole block. There are no replacement blocks, success-conditioned additions, model pilots, or post-outcome limit changes. This is one descriptive continuity experiment; it cannot estimate a population effect or isolate a causal contribution of memory.

The scene seed is 173, rendered sensor noise seed 440101, and schedule seed 440103. These values are chosen prospectively, before any Campaign 004 model invocation. Each C occurrence admits at most three fresh GPT-6 Astra / max sessions. Unused opportunities are not launched. The sole bootstrap and every task-template byte remain the Campaign 003 versions. The allowance is protected from the model; session IDs are opaque.

An accepted handback requires public completion, real conventional resumption, independently recorded placement acceptance, complete native retirement and truthful terminal continuity. A normal unresolved session may continue only through the frozen protected continuation checks: no pending or unknown motion, safe settled workcell, retired authority and namespaces, complete independently replayed filesystem prefix, zero open handles and the same order. A rejected handback alone neither succeeds nor disqualifies this path. No operator manipulation or repair is allowed during the block.

The third unresolved session ends that occurrence and stops the block; later occurrences are not run. An earlier ending without safe continuation also stops the block. Observed physical unsafe behavior or a clean bounded model deadline can be task failure; uncertain authority/motion outcomes, broken timing, incomplete evidence, invalid model execution or other apparatus failures make the result invalid/unknown. No fourth session, restart, task coaching or replacement is admitted.

Per-session model/simulation/wall and action/observation limits remain 3600/4200/4500 seconds and 120/50. Block duration and evidence capacities are fixed by limits.json. Resource admission is checked before launch; failure preserves a not-launched or invalid disposition, rather than relaxing reserves. The final freeze binds exact runtime, inherited sources, allocation, qualification gates and the director's authorization transcript prefix.

The evidence plan retains each actual session and each occurrence disposition, public model/tool/image events, command receipts, all filesystem read/mutation history and exact content bytes, physical state at model end, all continuation/handback/resumption/retirement records and native timing. Image use is optional behavior. Later analysis distinguishes artifact existence, actual read, execution, semantic reuse, adaptation, rediscovery, useful transfer and causal contribution. Only observable public outputs support behavioral findings; hidden reasoning is neither retained nor reconstructed.

The final synchronized replay joins public model/tool events, world observations/images, protected evaluator views explicitly labeled as analyst-only, exact filesystem states/diffs and session boundaries with measured cross-clock bounds. Derived files do not alter the frozen sources or raw evidence. All development failures, campaign invalidities and unrun occurrences remain visible.
summary: One three-occurrence persistent block; at most three fresh GPT-6 Astra / max sessions per occurrence, hidden allowance, no replacements.
